$matchId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['mode']) && (newData.child('mode').val() === 'manual' || newData.child('mode').val() === 'goals') && (!newData.child('scoreA').exists() || (newData.child('scoreA').isNumber() && newData.child('scoreA').val() >= 0 && newData.child('scoreA').val() <= 99)) && (!newData.child('scoreB').exists() || (newData.child('scoreB').isNumber() && newData.child('scoreB').val() >= 0 && newData.child('scoreB').val() <= 99))

$reportId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['detail','status','createdAt']) && newData.child('detail').isString() && newData.child('detail').val().length > 0 && newData.child('detail').val().length <= 1000 && newData.child('status').isString() && (newData.child('status').val() === 'new' || newData.child('status').val() === 'done') && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('createdAt').val() <= now + 60000

$viewId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['page','at','day']) && newData.child('page').isString() && newData.child('page').val().length <= 80 && newData.child('at').isNumber() && newData.child('at').val() <= now + 60000 && newData.child('day').isString() && newData.child('day').val().length <= 10
